ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback. The 2025 Spirit Grills utilize a Snap-Jet ignition system built into each control knob, and each burner is turned to light. We recommend pushing and holding the control knob in for two seconds, then turning it counterclockwise to the high position until you hear it snap. Hold the control knob in for two seconds after the snap for the igniter to spark and ignite the grill.

I hope this information helps. Please don’t hesitate to reach out to us directly if you encounter any issues with the ignition. We will be more than happy to help. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

I bought it off the company website. It took two weeks to ship no problem. Came with a damaged burners had to replace the burners. Reinstalled them the grill still still was not able to reach anything close to sear temperature after 25 minutes on high on the grill I was unable to grilla burger in 20 minutes. I have to return my grill
Because theres no more However this price tag for this grill does not meet anything close to the price tag. A Walmart grill gets hotter maybe not even but hotter which is crazy. The only thing they could
Do is give me my money back which still takes processing time so be cautious of these new products not the same Weber not the same company and certainly not the same customer service. They will play you wait for the grill to get picked up
And play games because they cannot do anything better for a customer who paid 600 dollars.

After installing the new regulator and hose, we used it 3 times and the new regulator developed a leak.   I have reorpted that and have no reply yet.  I can't use the grill that I purchased.  We chose a Weber bucause of it's reported reliability, but have bee greatly disappointed.

Results.ReviewText: Not a lot to say about the E325 that hasn’t been said by everyone else…I’ve had Webers for over 40 years, and this one performs just like the others…perfect performance.

Results.ReviewText: The Spirit E-325 replaces my 10 year old Spirit, which had developed rust issues. The improvements are excellent, including the sear zone option. Finish is very good, the ignitors are better, and I am very happy with the purchase.

Results.ReviewText: A great grill without a big price. Heats evenly and doesn’t flare thanks to the flavor bar design. Very well constructed and easy to operate and clean. Don’t be fooled by those slightly less expensive gas grills, you’ll be throwing those away in 2-3 years. Webers last.
Results.Title: It’s a quality item.

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill, its my fourth Weber grill, I love that each burner has its own igniter just push in the knob and it lights.. The 3 burners are great they give off plenty of cooking heat and the SEAR feature is fantastic,,
Results.Title: THIS GRILL IS GREAT

Results.ReviewText: When we had our house we had one of the bigger Weber natural gas BBQ for almost 25 years & it still worked perfectly so we left it for the new owners. We now live in a garage suite at our daughters & we made sure to have natural gas for the balcony, the Weber Spirit E-325 natural gas is perfect for our setup. It did take a bit of getting used to as after 25 year with the old Weber I knew instinctively where to set the knobs for what I was grilling but after a couple of meals I think I’ve got the new one down pat.
Results.Title: Another Great Weber Product

Results.ReviewText:
I am 85 year old woman and very disappointed in my new Spirit 325 BBQ ... and have to live with it ... probably my last of 3 Webers
1 - new wheels!  Really!  They only push straight and most of the time we pull a BBQ STRAIGHT OUT THEN TURN TO OPEN
2- BBQ HEAVY AND DIFFICULT FOR ME to lift or try abs push back in place!b. My older model had wheels that could turn on the wider side.  This newer model only has wheels that don't turn AND ONLY ON ONE END.
3 I have used it twice and hate that there is not lower tray I can put foil on and pull out for cleaning.  Can't believe new interior cleaning directions.

Very very disappointed and with new cover a....$600 and a big hunk of my monthly social security check!

Shame on Weber!
